cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Keep the Peace
cards.instruction: Hide a truth because you believe the relationship cannot survive one more conflict.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. The missing savings are a banking complication. Please keep our anniversary reservation. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Did you lend your sister money again?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. It's coming back Friday. Last time we discussed her, you asked for separate bedrooms.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let me handle the complication. I'd like us still sharing a table when the money arrives.

mechanism: A confidently claims management of missing savings and yields anniversary arrangements to keep B from investigating a truth thought likely to split them again.
confusable: Unlike mere financial face-saving, A connects concealment to separate bedrooms and lost connection; borrowed authority accommodates the shared outing to keep B engaged.
comparison: Bank inquiry and anniversary table differ from a physical letter under a breakfast plate.
seedUse: Use D87-b banking complication/sister/Friday/bedrooms/reservation and S02-b adaptive control of participation.
